cpr.title: Koma Ho Mmoa — Ɔbarima/Ɔbaa
cpr.warning: Frɛ 193 ANSA. Yɛ koma ho mmoa saa a onipa no nnyinii na ɔnhome mpofirim.

steps.instruction: Hwɛ sɛ babi no ho hɔ yɛ krado, afei hwɛ onipa no. Bɔ ne mfomso denden na teɛ sɛ "Wo ho yɛ wo sɛn?"
Frɛ 193 (Oman Ambulance) ntɛmntɛm anaa bisa biribi bi obi wɔ hɔ a okye frɛ no. Sie speaker mu.
Da onipa no akyi wɔ babi a ehow yɛ papa, baabi a eho a emu yɛ sɛn. Fa ne ti sɛ n'akyi kɔ mpofirim na twe ne abotenten so ama nsuahu aba mu.
Hwɛ sɛ ɔhome mpofirim no. Na meresua so akyi a ɔhome mpofirim. Hwɛ sɛ waguru wɔ koma anim, tie na fa w'anopɔ hwɛ.
steps.tip: Homehome a ɛba mpofirim mpofirim no NA home mpofirim — hyɛ koma ho mmoa ase.

steps.instruction: Si w'anopɔ baabi a eguru wɔ koma anim (wɔ anaafo fa). Si nsa fofor so, fa wɔ nyinaa bɔ mu, na tena a wo nsa mu yɛ sɛn.
Piem denden na ntɛm — piem bɔ 5 sentimita (inkyi 2) ketewaa wɔ homehome dɔn 100–120.
steps.tip: Susu Stayin' Alive dwom a ɔhome mu no — ɛno na ɛyɛ ntɛm a ɛsɛ.

steps.instruction: Wɔ akyi a wupiem ntam 30, ma ahome agu 2: twe n'afi so, si w'anom so n'anom so, home kosi sɛ n'abrewa goro. Dwuma 30:2 no siw kɔsi sɛ mmoa ba.
steps.tip: Sɛ w'ani gyina ahome agu so a, piem a ɛnyɛ nsɛe gu bi bɔ ho mmoa.

choking.title: Aguare Wɔ Emu — Heimlich
choking.warning: Sɛ onipa no tumi twitwa denden a, kyerɛ no sɛ ɔntwitwa ntɛm. Hyɛ ase wɔ saa nna a onipa no ntumi ntwitwa, nkasa anaa nhome no.

steps.instruction: Bisabisa denden sɛ "Woguan emu?" Sɛ ɔntumi nkasa, ntwitwa, anaa nhome no a — yɛ saa ntɛmntɛm.
Gyina n'akyi, fa no si n'anim kɔ so mpofirim, fa w'anopɔ yi ne mfomso so fa w'anopɔ gyamma bɔ ne afie anim bɔ 5. Hwɛ n'anom wɔ akyi bɔ biara.
Sɛ mfomso bɔ no anyɛ adwuma a, gyina n'akyi na fa wo nsa bɔ n'afoa ho.
Fa wo nsa bɔ mufuo na si — akokonin fa — wɔ nufinam a ɛwɔ asafoano a etia koma no ase.
Fa wo nsa fofor fa wo mufuo so. Twe denden a ɛkɔ mu na ɛkɔ soɔ — bɔ ntam 5.
steps.tip: Bɔ biara wɔ mu na ɛwɔ no ntɛm, ɛbɔ sɛ ɛkɔ bɔ nea ɛsi mu no gu.

steps.instruction: Paapae mfomso bɔ 5 ne nsa ho twe 5 kosi sɛ nea ɛsi mu no gu anaa onipa no hwie ase.
Sɛ ɔhwie ase a, fa no gu ase mma na hyɛ koma ho mmoa ase. Frɛ 193 ntɛmntɛm.

bleeding.title: Mogya A Ɛpue Denden
bleeding.warning: Frɛ 193 wɔ mogya a epue denden anaa ɛnso. MFA nea ɛhyɛ mogya mu no.

steps.instruction: Hwe do — fa ntamadan sɛ wowɔ, anaasɛ fa fidie anaa ntama ketewa a epɔ yɛ dee sɛ ɔdan.
Si denden, atitire wɔ mogya mu baabi no ho a wotumi fa ntama a efi ne so, koto anaa ntama. Piem denden na tena saa.
MFA ntama no ho na w'ani hwɛ — eyi mogya ho siw. Sɛ mogya de ntama no so a, fa ntama fofor si so na piem denden.
steps.tip: Sie dua a ɛkɔ bɔ 10–15 miniti a wonfa mu.

steps.instruction: Sɛ mogya mu baabi no wɔ owonkyerɛni na ɛtɔn gyina a, si kama wɔ 5–7 sentimita wɔ mogya mu baabi no soro. Hyɛ kɔsi sɛ mogya no gyina. Twe berɛ a wosiɛe no ase.
Sie onipa no na ma no hyia. Da no ase na boro n'anammuo (gyina a onipa no ti/kon a ɛtɔ so na a wosusuw saa a) na eyi shocks ɔhaw no mfiase.

burns.title: Ɔgya Mu Yadeɛ
burns.warning: Frɛ 193 wɔ ɔgya mu yadeɛ a ɛboro onipa no ntam so, anaa n'aniwa/nsa/mmaredwa baabi, anaa ɔgya a ɛba fi asɛe anaa ogya a ɛba fi ɔhankra.

steps.instruction: Fa onipa no fi ɔhaw no mu. Wɔ asɛe ɔgya a ɛba, piam asɛe a ɛyɛ dede no ansa na woyi ntama (bɔ sɛ ɛhia, mfa n'eti so nkɔ).
Si ɔgya mu baabi no wɔ nsu a ɛyɛ ya (ɛnsɛ nsutene anaa nsu a eye dwo) kosi sɛ miniti 20 apue.
steps.tip: Hyɛ ase wɔ dɔnhwere 3 mu. Mmoa koro yi yɛ adwuma pa sen biribi fofor.

steps.instruction: Bere a wosi su no mu, yi fam, saa ne ntama a ɛbɛn ɔgya mu baabi no — GYINA sɛ ɛhyɛ wɔ ho no.
NNFA ngo, dafuruwa ho aduro, ɔkɔtɔbere, nkukuu, anaa aduro a ɛfiri fie. MMPAE su adepam.
Kata ho maa mma na ɛnhyɛ — fa fidie a emu yɛ krado, ɛnsɛ totoɛ. Da so na kata ma.
Hyɛ onipa no hyia wɔ ntama (gya ɔgya mu baabi no ho) na wɔanhome wɔ nsu so dɔn a ɛwɔ.

seizure.title: Adwene Ho Ɔhaw Mmoa
seizure.warning: Frɛ 193 sɛ: adwene ho ɔhaw no yɛ ɔhaw tenten, ɛtwa 5 miniti, onipa no nnyae, anaa wɔabuae no.

steps.instruction: Tena asomdwoe mu. Hwɛ berɛ a adwene ho ɔhaw no hyɛ ase. Adwene ho ɔhaw pii a ɛwie wɔ wɔn ankasa mu wɔ miniti 1–3 mu.
Bɔ onipa no ho ban — si biribi a eho yɛ mema ne ti ase. Fa nea ehow na ɛyɛ nwonwa yi fi ne ho.
MMFA ne mu. MMPUE ne gyinabeha. MMFA biribi nto n'anom mu.
steps.tip: Nnipa ntumi ntɔ wɔn tεtεa. Biribi a watɔ n'anom mu yɛ ɔhaw na ɛnyɛ no.

steps.instruction: Sɛ wobɛtumi a, fa no fa dane n'akyi kɔ so ne abotenten (adwene ho ɔhaw baabi) na nsuahu no ntwa.
Tena ne ho kɔsi sɛ ɔsan bɛnya n'adwene. Kasa asomdwoe mu na ma no gyina — ɔbɛyɛ abofra amanfraani na ɔbɛsuro wɔ miniti kakra akyi.

eye.title: Aniwa Mu Yadeɛ
eye.warning: Hwehwɛ ntɛm na woakɔ aniwa mu yadeɛ biara, asɛe mu nwura, anaa aniwa ho hunu da ne kwan so.

steps.instruction: MMFA aniwa no — eyi yadeɛ biara bɛboro. Sie onipa no sɛ ɔtenabena asomdwoe mu.
Asɛe a egu aniwa no ho: ntɛm nsu a efi pɔn mu de ho hwi aniwa mu wɔ miniti 15–20, fa anifutuo no tete. Fa ti no gu a nsu no trɛw fi aniwa fofor no so.
Biribi a atɔ aniwa mu: gyina bɔne mu ntɛm anaa fa nsu de ho hwi. MMFA biribi a ahyɛ aniwa mu yi fi hɔ.
Kata aniwa a ɛwɔ yadeɛ mu no maa mma wɔ ntama a efi ne so — mmpiem so. Kata aniwa mmienu wɔ aniwa a nwura abɔ mu ho na ɛni gyinabeha.
Kɔ asupɔn anaa aniwa klinki ntɛmntɛm, na yadeɛ no amaa n'ase da.
Gyina yadeɛ mu baabi no koraa. MMPAE ano yere. Sie mu wɔ baabi a wohuu no so wɔ wo nsa anaa ntama a wotoɔ.
Hwɛ mogya a ɛtrɛw wɔ yadeɛ mu baabi no ase: hwɛ no ho, hwɛ wɔ no anwɔnwɔ ne ne nso, na bisabisa sɛ ne ho yɛ no ahusam anaa ɔhome.
steps.tip: Wɔ anwɔnwɔ anaa ntini bi wɔ yadeɛ mu baabi no ase no yɛ sign sɛ mogya a ɛtrɛw nso daa — eyi yɛ ntɛm.

steps.instruction: Sɛ osiw a wɔhuu bone no (asiw no huu): kata maa mma wɔ ntama a efi ne so — MMPIEM asiw no so. Piem mogya wɔ mu baabi no ho, na ɛnyɛ n'ani so.
Sie osiw a ɛhia na wukɔ: fa biribi a emu yɛ sɛn (bankye, krataa a wotoɔ) a wototo ntama so. Sie wɔ osiw no soro ne ase — mfri n'ani so.
Si dɔɔso a emu yɛ ya (a wototo ntama so) na eyi nteteɛ. Hyɛ onipa no hyia, bɔ shocks ho mmoa, na tie kɔsi sɛ mmoa ba.

poisoning.title: Nseɛ / Aduro Tumi A Ɛboro
poisoning.warning: Frɛ 193 ntɛmntɛm. MMFA ho kosi sɛ dokota bi ɔkyerɛ wo — eyi ɔhaw fofor bɛtumi aba.

steps.instruction: Frɛ 193 ntɛmntɛm anaa fa onipa no kɔ asupɔn a ɛbɛn. Ka nseɛ no din, dɛm, ne berɛ a wode no sɛ wuhu.
Sɛ wanyinii na n'adwene wɔ n'ani so a, bisabisa sɛ ɔde deɛn. Sie na kyerɛ dokota a ɔba no fidie, toɔtu, anaa nseɛ no.
MMFA biribi ma no wɔ aduan anaa nsu. MMFA ho kosi sɛ dokota bi ɔka saa.
Sɛ ɔhwie ase nanso ɔhome a, da no akyi kɔ so ne abotenten (n'akyi kɔ soɔ) na ɔnhome ahu nea ɛguro.
Sɛ onhome biara a, hyɛ koma ho mmoa ase. Hwɛ n'ahome ne n'adwene a ɛwɔ n'ani so kɔsi sɛ mmoa ba.
Wɔ ho/aniwa asɛe mu nwura a: yi ntama a asɛe agu mu no na de nsu pɔn de si ho wɔ miniti 20 mpofirim.
